tower.Fp: canonical <p, two u256 limbs; not Montgomery internals

checkpoint: G2 line state and signed-x Miller cursor
continuation_design.transition_rule: Only contract-computed or algebraically checked transitions from the authenticated previous checkpoint; never trust uploaded line/GT/host-success values.
continuation_design.gt_targets: Separate IdentityTarget tag from ActualGT(value). Never globally replace literal GT generator by multiplicative identity.
continuation_design.pow: Fixed exponent bit schedule; checked inverses; exact tower/line embedding and final-exponent convention require source/vector validation.
session_binding: full VK and verifier SRS hashes
old CT and proposed new CT

stages.name: BEGIN
stages.rule: Bind full statement; at most one pending next batch; no accepted CT/NF writes.

stages.name: ADVANCE
stages.rule: Enforce session, next micro-PC and authenticated registers; resume all required operations.

stages.name: FINISH
stages.rule: All nine categories, ten pairing relations and G1 endpoint complete before VERIFIED.

stages.name: CONSUME
stages.rule: Fixed receiver only; recheck current old CT/index/root/fresh NFs, exact matrix and state proof; consume once and update CT/NFs atomically.

stages.name: ABORT
stages.rule: Incomplete/expired/out-of-budget session is not accepted; preserve accepted business state, never reinterpret as cryptographic INVALID or VERIFIED.

continuation_design.equivalence_obligation: Inductively relate every checkpoint/terminal result to the chosen supported-domain verifier relation; explicitly account for randomized batching/sentinel semantics and completeness.
continuation_design.rejection_sampling: Original data-dependent cumulative-hash rejection loop has no established practical worst-case cap. A resource watchdog gives ABORT/INCOMPLETE, not proof invalidity or unconditional full-domain completion.
continuation_design.public_chain_time: Local wall time does not bound transaction inclusion/finality time.
